name: Kogilu
tagline: A lake-side identity within the Yelahanka network.
description: Kogilu sits within the wider Yelahanka–Jakkur residential setting, with Kogilu Main Road and Kogilu Lake providing local reference points. Apartment communities have different approaches towards Bellary Road and Thanisandra Main Road. A home’s tower, access road and layout are more useful comparison points than the broad northern-city label.
